title: A costing is locked from the moment its quotation goes for approval; a revision gets its own editable copy when the figures must change

steps.do: Open the costing while its quotation is still a Draft.
steps.expect: "Reopen as draft" is offered — nobody has priced from it yet.
steps.observed: While Q-00001 is still a draft, "Reopen as draft" is offered — but only to Test MktMgr, who gave the highest approval. Test BDM, who prepared it, is not offered it: "🔒 Only Test MktMgr, who gave the highest approval, may reopen an approved costing — or, when they are away, the person they delegated their approvals to, or someone above them." (SAL-188, 14 Nov 2026).
steps.suggest: [The last approver] Open the costing while its quotation is still a Draft → "Reopen as draft" is offered — nobody has priced from it yet. (The preparer is not offered it — SAL-188.)

steps.do: Submit the quotation for approval → open the costing.
steps.expect: No "Reopen as draft". The band reads "🔒 This costing is Approved and read-only. Q-… has gone for approval. The costing is the record of how that price was worked out, so it is locked. To change the figures, raise a revision of the quote — the revision gets its own copy of this costing, to edit and approve."
steps.observed: Quotation submitted ("Submitted for approval — 2 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager); then, last, level 2: Test MktMgr (Marketing Manager)."). On the costing: no "Reopen as draft"; the band reads "🔒 This costing is Approved and read-only. Approved by Test MktMgr. Q-00001 has gone for approval. The costing is the record of how that price was worked out, so it is locked. To change the figures, raise a revision of the quote — the revision gets its own copy of this costing, to edit and approve."
steps.note: A quotation at exactly its approved costing's prices needs no approval (it reads "No approval needed — your approval rules do not cover this value" and offers "✉ Send to client" directly), so to send it for approval a lump-sum "Travel and lodging" line was added with the price note.
steps.suggest: Add: "(A quotation at exactly its costing's prices needs no approval and goes straight to Send — the lock then starts at Send.)"

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] approve the quotation → [BDM] open the costing. (The owner's case.)
steps.expect: Still no "Reopen as draft": "… has been approved. …". The same after "Send", "won" and a contract.
steps.observed: Still no "Reopen as draft", even for the last approver — approved: "… has been approved. …"; sent: "… has gone to the client (sent …)"; won: "… has been won — the client accepted it."; contract: "Q-00002 has a contract (AHM/C/2026-27/00001).".

steps.do: On the quotation press "Revise (new rev)" → type why ("Client asked for two more engineers") → "Create revision". (From 14 Nov 2026 the copy is made by itself — SAL-190.)
steps.expect: "Created revision 01 … Its costing <number> Rev 01 was made from <number> Rev 00 as a draft — change the figures there and submit it for approval."
steps.observed: Message: "Created revision 01 with 2 line(s) and 0 site(s) carried over. Edit it below. Its costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 was made from AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 00 as a draft — change it in the Costing tab here, then submit it for approval."
steps.note: The message ends "— change it in the Costing tab here, then submit it for approval." (SAL-195: the revision's costing is changed in its Costing tab) instead of "— change the figures there and submit it for approval."
steps.suggest: "… Its costing <number> Rev 01 was made from <number> Rev 00 as a draft — change it in the Costing tab here, then submit it for approval."

steps.do: Open the revision's costing (from its Costing card).
steps.expect: A Draft with every role and setting copied, the same number ending "Rev 01", and "Revisions: Rev 00 (approved) · Rev 01 (this one, draft)". Add a role or change a head — it saves.
steps.observed: Opened AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 (Draft) from the Costing card: every role and setting copied; "Revisions: Rev 00 (approved) · Rev 01 (this one, draft)"; a new role "Additional Engineer" saved.

steps.expect: Unchanged and still locked — it is the record of the price that went out. Its history: "Copied to … Rev 01 for Q-… revision 1 by <you>". The new one's history: "Costing … Rev 01 copied from … Rev 00 by <you> …".
steps.observed: Rev 00 unchanged (1 role) and read-only; its history: "Copied to … Rev 01 for Q-00001 revision 1 by Test BDM"; Rev 01's: "Costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 copied from AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 00 by Test BDM …".

steps.do: Submit the new costing for approval; once approved, submit the revision.
steps.expect: A man-month revision goes forward once its own copy is approved — before that it is refused: "… Costing … Rev 01 is linked, but it is still a draft …". When the revision goes for approval, its copy locks in turn.
steps.observed: Before Rev 01 was approved the revision could not go forward (no Submit button; in its place "⚠ Not ready to submit: A man-month quote goes forward only once its project costing is approved. Costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 is linked, but it is stil") — forced: "A man-month quote goes forward only once its project costing is approved. Costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 is linked, but it is still a draft — open it, fill in the cost heads and press "Submit f". Once Rev 01 was approved it went for approval ("Submitted for approval — 2 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager); the

steps.do: NEGATIVE · Press "Change the costing for this revision" (if an old page still shows it).
steps.expect: Refused: its costing is already editable — open it. No second copy.
steps.observed: Pressing "Change the costing for this revision" on a revision that already has its own draft copy is refused: "Its costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0003 Rev 01 is already editable — open it." — no second copy.

steps.do: NEGATIVE · Open an older revision of the quotation.
steps.expect: No "Change the costing" button; a forced press is refused: "This is an older revision — open the current one."
steps.observed: Rev 00 reads "This is an earlier revision." with no "Change the costing" button; a forced press: "This is an older revision — open the current one.".

steps.do: EDGE · A quotation that never went for approval, with an approved costing.
steps.expect: No copy button — the costing is not held by the quotation; "Reopen as draft" on the costing is the way.
steps.observed: Costing card: "🧮 Project costing: AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0004 Rev 00 — Never sent for approval revenue ₹7.73 L · margin 23.8% Unlink" — no copy button. A forced copy is refused: "Its costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0004 Rev 00 is not held by a quote that went for approval — open it and use "Reopen as draft"."

steps.do: EDGE · A draft costing whose quotation has gone for approval.
steps.expect: Locked too — its roles cannot be changed until a revision gets its own copy.
steps.observed: The Draft costing whose quotation is waiting for approval shows "🔒 This costing is Draft and read-only — locked by its quote. Q-00004 has gone for approval. The costing is the record of how that price was worked out, so it is locked. To change the figures, raise a revision of the quote — the revision gets its own copy of this costing, to edit and approve."; no role box or settings form; a forced role delete changes nothing.
